title: Zephyrine and the Postcard
author: Xanthe Vane
blurb: Coral Delacroix, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
